profile.headline: SWE at Microsoft | MS Cybersecurity @ Georgia Tech
profile.summary:
👋🏽 Hi, my name is Malcolm!

🎓 Computer Science graduate from the University of Guelph w/ a minor in Business and current Masters Cybersecurity student at Georgia Tech. Relevant Coursework: Data Structures, Algorithms, Operating Systems, OOP, Databases, Cryptography, Computer Security, Introduction to Information Security.

📚 Throughout my time in school, I've previously interned at Microsoft, Wealthsimple, and Tulip as a Software Engineer. Current SWE at Microsoft.

💻 Passionate about learning & tech. Eager to grow and learn whenever possible

💪🏽 In my free time, I love exercising, music, podcasts, and documentaries.

👀 Here's a link to my GitHub: https://github.com/mbw101

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Empowering Excel users to leverage Python capabilities by designing, developing, and deploying low-latency C & C++ code.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant - CIS 1200 (Introduction to Computing)
positions.description:
• Responded to student emails and questions in a class size of 600 students
• Graded assignments and discussions of 100 students
• Attended weekly meetings on Slack with the professor and TA team

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented a feature within Tasks by Planner for 20k+ headquarter customers using C# and React, which allows customization of how notifications are delivered when a task list is published or unpublished.
• Integrated the GPT-3.5 model with FluentUI components in a Copilot sidecar experience to display a project status report, enabling project managers to view and share highlights and challenges of a project.
positions.insights: Skills: npm · C# · GraphQL · React.js · TypeScript · Windows · Yarn

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Created a cron job and an SQS queue to facilitate the auto-sell process, which allows clients to recoup money if they have insufficient funds/shares for their expiring in-the-money options contracts.
• Built 2 Slackbots that display auto-sell batch information at the end of every market day, allowing ~200 stakeholders across teams to track when expiring in-the-money options contracts are automatically sold to the market. 
• Utilized Kotlin lambda expressions and high-order function techniques inside a shared helper class, decreasing code repetition by 75% between 4 cron jobs.
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · PostgreSQL · Amazon SQS · Spring Framework · Spring Boot · Kafka

positions.title: Teaching Assistant - CIS 1200 (Introduction to Computing)
positions.description:
• Responded to discussions posts and emails in a class size of approximately 400 students.
• Attended weekly meetings on Slack with the professor and TA team.
• Marked assignments and discussion posts of groups with 100 students.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Researched and implemented a dockerized reverse proxy within an Azure VM, allowing for requests to be distributed to the correct service based on the request format.
• Leveraged Redis as a provider of dynamic configuration, providing configuration for routers, services, and middlewares to the reverse proxy.
• Created a Grafana metrics dashboard for observability, enabling the team to see real-time traffic visuals on all requests that hit the reverse proxy.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Work · Management · Git · Flask · Redis · Microsoft Azure · Azure DevOps · Microsoft Teams · Docker · Python (Programming Language) · Programming · Windows

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Created custom hooks along with Jest unit tests for the webchat widget giving clients the ability to track specific conversation metrics.
• Increased keyboard accessibility by 165% using JavaScript, allowing the user to navigate the web chat widget entirely with the keyboard.
• Added ARIA content on UI elements for a 100% improvement with screen reader accessibility.
• Contributed to the PHP back end of the Tulip API allowing conversations to be reassigned and for linked customers to be removed within the iOS LiveConnect app.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Work · HTML5 · Git · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Azure DevOps · Programming · PHP

positions.title: Explore Intern (Software Engineering + Program Management)
positions.description:
• Optimized, consolidated and documented a financial record reprocessing tool in C#, resulting in a 50x speedup by leveraging parallelization and streamlining the workflow.
• Developed an actionable dashboard in Power BI to display unrecognized accounting value of gift cards and tokens up to $10 million.
• Worked in a pod of two other interns, leveraged knowledge from multiple full-time employees and worked in partnership with other teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Work · Management · Git · Microsoft Azure · C# · Azure DevOps · Microsoft Teams · Programming · Windows

positions.title: Teaching Assistant - CIS 1500 (Introduction to Programming)
positions.description:
• Taught introductory concepts of computer science: variables, scope, control structures, arrays, strings, and Unix in three 50-minute weekly lab sessions.
• Marked worksheets and programming assignments in a class size of approximately 800 students with great attention to detail and in a timely manner.
• Ensured students understood the material and answered any questions through weekly office hours.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Work · Management · Git · C (Programming Language) · Microsoft Teams · Programming · Windows

positions.title: Team Leader
positions.description:
• Led a team of 10-15 team members during a variety of different shifts to achieve upselling, drive-thru times, and to complete daily chores.
• Trained and mentored between 15-20 employees to ensure they know the work procedures and a thorough understanding of the products and the POS system.
• Recorded food waste in throw logs to carefully measure the amount of product thrown for the day.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Work · Team Leadership · Management · Customer Service

projects.title: Excel 40th Anniversary Snake Game
projects.description:
• Competed in Microsoft’s internal Fix Hack Learn (FHL) Hackathon, a week-long event for innovation and experimentation.
• Partnered in a two-person team to design and build a playable Snake game inside Excel, celebrating the application’s 40-year legacy.
• Implemented the project in C++ within Microsoft’s Office monorepo, showcasing both technical depth and creativity.
• Recognized in the Top 5 of 30 submissions within Excel US Engineering for originality and execution.

projects.title: XL Wrapped
projects.description:
• Collaborated in an eight-person team to design a functional Figma UI prototype of a Spotify-Wrapped for Excel, featuring many different Excel workbook statistics.

* Placed 4th out of top 10 of the most voted projects within Excel US Engineering. Microsoft's Fix Hack Learn (FHL) week-long Hackathon in a team of 8 to design a UX and a functional prototype that breaks down
